content.title: MY EXPERTISE
content.subtitle: Chronological timeline of studio VFX pipelines, generative AI direction, and visual production leadership.

companies.name: DNEG
companies.intro: Architecting studio GenAI pipelines and identity transfer for international feature films:
bullets: Scaled diffusion and LoRA training across DGX cluster infrastructure, delivering consistent character identity across 50+ film shots.
Engineered end-to-end generative workflows in ComfyUI, bridging synthetic assets into VFX compositing with Nuke validation.
Directed facial performance transfer, synthetic look-dev, and environmental extension pipelines across major feature film productions.

companies.name: IMPROMP2LABS
companies.intro: Leading end-to-end creative direction, IP development, and AI video campaigns for global brands:
bullets: Directed original cinematic IP projects from worldbuilding and character development to multi-shot trailer pipelines.
Spearheaded short-form cinematic campaigns for global enterprise clients including NFL, Porsche, and INDmoney.
Integrated generative video models and sound synthesis pipelines, accelerating creative turnaround times by 40%.

companies.name: CYBEREDGE
companies.intro: AI-assisted visual production and large-scale creative campaigns:
bullets: Engineered generative workflows for high-volume visual variation, composition, and layout exploration.
Directed virtual camera staging, lighting setups, and visual look-dev across commercial campaigns.
Implemented post-production pipelines bridging raw generative outputs into client-ready deliverables.

companies.name: PREMA SAI DESIGNERS
companies.intro: Graphic design, brand systems, and marketing creative production:
bullets: Designed comprehensive brand systems, identity guidelines, and visual communication frameworks.
Led high-volume marketing collateral and digital creative production across campaigns.
Explored AI-assisted workflow experimentation to accelerate ideation and asset generation.
